authority: #K2-467 sec.2.1(3) precheck, re-run under #K2-472 sec.3.4 with the TRUE-shape pad model

model.pads: TRUE anisotropic capsule (long axis), hw = min(size)/2 - NOT an isotropic max(size)/2 disc (R1520)
model.vias: circle on every layer of their layer-span (R1358)
model.escape: the asset ENDPOINT must lie outside the pad rect (#K2-472 sec.3.4(2))

interpretation.what_changed_vs_v1: R1498/R1506 modelled each pad as a POINT with an ISOTROPIC half-width max(size.x,size.y)/2 (0.7375mm for these 0.300x1.475 pads - 4.92x the true short half-axis), which MANUFACTURED the refusals (R1520). v2 models the true anisotropic capsule (hw = min(size)/2 = 0.150) and requires the escape endpoint to leave the pad rect.
interpretation.why_these_escapes_are_consistent_with_th: both pads are 0.300x1.475 long pads; the corridor runs along the LONG axis and leaves the pad at its end - exactly the short F.Cu run north to a via at ~(37.75,56.2) that the R1440 witness uses.
interpretation.margin_note: the first legal endpoint is reached at the 0.1mm step granularity, so the endpoint sits ~0.06mm beyond the pad edge; the criterion is the literal #K2-472 sec.3.4(2) rule (outside the pad rect).
interpretation.no_appendix_A: with go=TRUE there is NO dead exit for these two ends => appendix A (sec.16.3 relocation) must not be used.
